attributes.name: Druva - Login and Configuration Activity From Same Source
attributes.description: Detects login and configuration activity from same source in Druva Data Security Cloud events.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 8 – Behavioral Correlation & Threat Hunting

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 8 – Behavioral Correlation & Threat Hunting
meta.team_to_target: SOC; IAM/Identity; Security Engineering/GRC; Detection & Response
meta.customer_usecase: Detects login and configuration activity from same source in Druva Data Security Cloud events.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE source.ip IS NOT NULL AND (druva.event_type == "Admin Login" OR druva.event_type LIKE "*Configuration*")
| KEEP @timestamp, event.id, event.action, event.outcome, event.severity, druva.feature, druva.event_type, user.name, user.email, source.ip, druva.resource.name, message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 100
